name: Illinois Components

With a focus on precision and efficiency, we ensure that your components are securely packaged for automated assembly. Trust Illinois Components to continually produce products that you can truly depend on.
about:
Illinois Components, Inc. was founded in 1996 in Lombard, Illinois, by Tony and Keith Bondi, who serve as president and vice president respectively. The company began as a specialist in tape and reel services, focusing on surface mount taping for automated electronics assembly.

The firm provides a range of packaging and programming services for electronic components. Its core offerings include surface mount taping, radial and axial taping, tape and reel packaging, electronic component programming, cut and form operations, and inspection. Work is performed in a clean, modern facility using high-speed automated equipment that handles tape widths from 8 to 120 mm and reel diameters of 7, 13, 15, and 22 inches. The company also supplies metal stampings, spacers, and standoffs for the metals industry and offers custom carrier pocket designs and barcoded labeling.

Illinois Components serves the electronics manufacturing sector, handling all surface mount and through-hole devices, as well as the metals industry for spacers, stampings, screw-machine parts, and standoffs. Its customers are typically original equipment manufacturers and contract assemblers seeking to streamline production with reliable, standards-compliant packaging.

The company emphasizes rapid turnaround, quoting completion from inception to delivery in one week or less for custom solutions. It adheres to EIA taping standards and ESD procedures, and differentiates itself through custom pocket design, quick-turn programming, and a customer-centric approach that prioritizes precision and on-time delivery.
